title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Solo #04 (JapaneseMakie+EscherTessellation+TurkishIznik+MexicanTalavera)
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph with a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Ethiopian woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smooth warm-brown skin, a bold thick black liner drawn around the whole eye and winged slightly at the outer corner, warm gold and brown eyeshadow, strongly defined softly arched brows, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural warm rose-brown lip with a soft gloss, a serene, dignified expression, demure and soft, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in curly, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glossy finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin carries 4 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Japanese maki-e gold-powder lacquer (a deep glossy black urushi lacquer ground scattered with a traditional motif — cherry blossoms, cranes among pine, or maple leaves — rendered in fine sprinkled gold powder, wide gold-powder bands, dense gold powder glittering densely) dominates one zone. Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat, wide gold bands, dense morphing tessellation) dominates the second zone. Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems, wide cobalt-and-coral bands, dense floral scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, wide cobalt bands, dense medallion scrollwork) dominates the fourth zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Pose: both hands framing her own face.

Footwear: extreme extreme platform wedges, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Background & Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against her skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
